notes: Source is Blackmagic Design's own official "Product Technical Specifications" PDF (mirrored by authorized reseller Wiltronics; identical to Blackmagic's site content, confirmed against B&H/search cross-references). The device is a small desktop unit (134.1 x 92.25 x 23mm, 230g), not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted in spirit but set to 0 since the schema requires an integer if included — treat as not rack-mountable. Two distinct BNC reference inputs exist per the official rear-panel diagram: "SDI REF IN" (SDI reference only) and "REF IN" (black burst/tri-sync analog reference) — both inputs, both BNC, neither is a video-out/pass-through port. SDI outputs support up to 3G-SDI (SDI Rates: 1.5G, 3G) so graded sdi-3g. HDMI Out is HDMI Type A but Blackmagic does not publish an HDMI version number (1.4/2.0/2.1) for this product, so HDMI grade is omitted per instructions (spec doesn't state a version). Ethernet is 10/100/1000 BaseT, graded eth-1g (its top supported speed). USB-C port is explicitly for configuration/firmware updates only ("Updates and Configuration: 1x USB Type-C") — not a general data/video port — so no USB grade is set since no data-rate spec is given for it. Power input is a locking DC barrel jack (2.5mm ID x 5.5mm OD, center pin positive), closest match to allowed connector list is dc-barrel. Settings can also be set via onboard mini DIP switches (not a connector, omitted). No variant/regional differences noted beyond the included international socket adapters for the power supply.
